messages:
Maria Lopez: FYI I opened a PR that tries to unify the JS/Go snippets for 429/timeouts troubleshooting. link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4321
AJ Patel: saw it, thanks. quick skim showed the Go snippet still uses the old `TimeoutMs` param — our SDK switched to `timeout_ms` last quarter, causes copy/paste failures. :grimacing:
Devon K: ugh that's the one that made CI flake earlier. The test harness expects `timeout_ms` so the sample fails linting in examples CI.
docs-bot: build check queued for PR #4321 — docs-examples-ci
Oliver Chen: can we also add a tiny sandbox repro (curl + small prompt) so support can reproduce a 429 vs timeout? Right now the page explains theory but no quick repro.
Maria Lopez: good call. I'll add a `scripts/repro-429.sh` that hits the hosted API with low concurrency and tiny context to trigger rate limit in the sandbox env.
Samir Rao: note: the hosted API in sandbox returns 429 with `retry-after` header. Our doc text recommends exponential backoff but the snippet uses plain `sleep(1)`. We should show proper backoff pseudo-code.
Jen Lee: can someone confirm which retry header we should reference? I thought we standardized to `x-retry-after-ms` in dedicated, but hosted uses `Retry-After` seconds.
AJ Patel: correct — hosted -> `Retry-After` (seconds), Dedicated -> `x-retry-after-ms`. Docs need to call that out in the troubleshooting table.
Devon K: adding to that, the context-trim example currently removes tokens from the end (right-trim) which breaks some chained-tooling. We should recommend left-trim for most assistant-first prompts.
Maria Lopez: I'll update the migration note: "if using assistant-first prompts, prefer left-trim to preserve instruction tokens" — and add a one-liner explaining why.
docs-bot: PR #4321 — lint errors: 1) malformed fenced code block in docs/troubleshooting/429-and-timeouts.md 2) sample-js.json mismatch with sample-go.json
AJ Patel: I can take the JS snippet fix. Quick patch: rename `maxTokens` -> `max_tokens`, change `retry` param to use exponential backoff helper.
Oliver Chen: I'll align the Go one to mirror the retry logic and add comment about headers. Also will add an integration check that verifies sample outputs don't include raw stack traces.
Samir Rao: once patches are up, can we add a link from the error-reference page to the rollout runbook? Support asked where to look for fallback policies.
Maria Lopez: yes — I'll add a small section "Where to escalate" with links to runbook (internal) and public fallback guidance.
Jen Lee: small editorial note — the existing paragraph uses "429s are temporary" which is confusing. Suggest: "429s indicate temporary throttling; follow retry header guidance and implement client-side backoff and jitter"
Devon K: will also add a short test harness that simulates token window hits to exercise context-limit guidance. It's a tiny node script in `examples/context-window/test.js`.
Maria Lopez: going to update the PR with: fixed code blocks, unified params, added repro scripts, updated header table, and added the runbook link. pinging reviewers after push. :pray:
AJ Patel: awesome. once CI passes please @-mention support and eng-oncall for visibility.
docs-bot: docs site build passed for PR #4321 
Maria Lopez: pushed updates and left a short changelog in the PR. reviewers: @AJ Patel @Oliver Chen please take a final look when you can. :eyes:
Oliver Chen: reviewing now. minor nit: change "exponential backoff" example to include jitter snippet (2 lines).
AJ Patel: LGTM after that small jitter addition.
Samir Rao: thanks all — once merged I'll add a quick note to the KB so triage can link to the new repro scripts.
Maria Lopez: merging after AJ/Oliver approvals. Thanks everyone! :shipit:
